blurb: Golden Hills Golf Club offers 18 holes of PGA-rated championship golf with picturesque views, challenging par three holes, and well-manicured greens. The course features lush fairways lined with cottonwood and eucalyptus trees, serene lake settings, and mature vegetation. Amenities include a full practice facility, retail shop, refreshment cart, and event spaces for tournaments and private events.
